Professor – Dept of Commerce attended a 3-Day Capacity Development Programme organised by the Institute of Academic Excellence, Hyderabad from 27th to 29th April, 2023. The event was organised in collaboration with the Commissionerate of Collegiate and Technical Education, Telangana State and Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad. The venue was J- HUB Centre, JNTU Kukatpally campus, Hyderabad.
